messages:
Alice M.: ok team — proposing we target a small Q3 ship: Predictive Prefetch + Canary Routing to cut cold-start tokens and reduce cross-region failover cost. target: 6-week cadence. who can own end-to-end?
Jamal R.: I can lead runtime work. need to validate KV cache compatibility with multi-tenant models. rough estimate: 3 weeks dev + 1 week perf testing.
Priya K.: infra needs a reserved pool for canary lanes. will require a monthly commit for Dedicated GPUs or we fallback to burst. estimate: 2 weeks to provision and test.
Lina T.: eng (service layer) can wire the routing flags and rollout API. depends on runtime feature toggles and infra network routes. 1.5 weeks for feature flag + canary gating.
Marco S.: security: need threat model for cross-region cache replication and encryption-at-rest/KMS flow. send a short doc and we'll review within 3 business days. also require audit logging for rollout events.
Alice M.: thanks. immediate blockers: (1) infra commit, (2) runtime unit tests for KV boundaries, (3) security stub doc. If we can clear these this week we keep 6-week ship.
Jamal R.: working on unit tests now. small failing case where prefix eviction interferes with delayed streaming; will push a repro by EOD.
Priya K.: booked procurement sync for reserved pool options Weds 11am PT. tagging @alice for prioritization to justify commit.
Alice M.: added cost and business justification in the procurement thread. short: expect ~15% token cost reduction for latency-sensitive routes -> saves ~30% monthly for customer X.
Lina T.: quick note on rollout strategy: propose 2-step canary: 1) internal lane, 2) 5% of external traffic with traffic steering by route. we should support instant rollback.
Marco S.: confirm we can do KMS key rotation without downtime? infra?
Priya K.: yes we can, but need to test with runtime key caching. will include key-rotation test in infra playbook.
Jamal R.: marker: runtime needs a small API change to expose cache-health metrics (hit_rate, evict_rate). Lina, can you add to route schema?
Lina T.: yep will add a /v1/routes/:id/metrics hook. minimal change.
Alice M.: owners: product=Alice, runtime=Jamal, infra=Priya, eng=Lina, security=Marco. Action items for this week: 1) Jamal push repro tests (EOD), 2) Priya bring procurement options (Weds), 3) Marco send threat-model stub (Thu), 4) Lina add metrics hook PR (Thu).
deploy-bot: deploy-check: CI lint/presubmit passed for jamal/runtime/prefetch-tests branch.
Jamal R.: pushed tests and a short repro to the PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/3421 — please review.
Lina T.: starting the metrics hook PR now, will request review from Jamal once tests are stable.
Priya K.: procurement presented two options: reserved pool (higher up-front, lower run cost) vs burst (no commit, higher unit cost). annotated pros/cons in procurement doc: https://docs.redwood/procurement/prefetch-pool.
Alice M.: decision needed by Fri COB. if we go reserved, we'll lock in infra by next sprint.
Marco S.: threat model stub posted: https://docs.redwood/security/prefetch-threatmodel.md — highlights: replication KMS, internal auth for canary lanes, log retention. please review.
Jamal R.: quick ask: can infra provide a small staging region to run cross-region failover tests? would shorten perf testing to 1 week.
Priya K.: ok can allocate a staging region for 2 weeks if we commit to a test plan. send schedule and we'll approve.
Alice M.: I'll assemble test plan today and DM @Priya. also setting up a 30m sync Thurs 9am PT to confirm blockers and risks. calendar invite incoming.
Lina T.: pinging @Marco for required audit log fields so I can include them in the rollout events schema.
Marco S.: audit fields: actor, actor_id, route_id, model_variant, decision_reason, timestamp, rollback_flag. add encrypted payload for sensitive props.
Lina T.: noted.
Priya K.: updated infra checklist with staging region + KMS test steps. link: https://docs.redwood/infra/prefetch-checklist.
Alice M.: great work. final note: let's keep canary small and measurable. success metrics = 1) 10% reduction in median cold-start latency for critical routes, 2) no more than 1% error delta, 3) clear cost delta report after 2 weeks. we'll gate the full rollout on those. :thumbsup:
Jamal R.: agreed. pulling together perf harness.
deploy-bot: reminder: weekly-deploy-window Thurs 02:00 UTC. be mindful of canary timings.
Alice M.: thanks everyone — sync Thurs 9am PT. if anyone hits a blocker before then, drop updates here. :rocket:
